description: This file defines the EmpDependentDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the EmpDependent entity. It provides additional methods for retrieving formatted date of birth, setting employee references by employee number, and fetching relationship type information with specific formatting.

classes.name: EmpDependentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpDependent entity that provides additional functionality for handling dependent-related data, such as formatted date of birth and relationship description.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmpDependent entity instance.

methods.name: getEmpDependent
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the encapsulated EmpDependent entity.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of birth of the dependent, or null if not available.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with the dependent using the employee number, fetching the Employee entity reference.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship type as a string, formatted with the first letter capitalized, with special handling if the relationship type is 'Other'.
